title: WATCH THIS Before Fighting Velgar in Dragonwilds

description:
Velgar is the first main boss in RuneScape Dragonwilds, but he isn’t as scary as he seems. Even without resorting to the pedestal exploit, you can easily take down this boss with the proper preparation. This comprehensive guide covers everything you need to conquer the fight, including how to summon Velgar, the best consumables to pack, an ideal boss-slaying loadout, and step-by-step combat strategies.
